papers.title: Predicting the fatigue life of an AlSi10Mg alloy manufactured via laser powder bed fusion by using data from computed tomography
papers.first_author_affiliation: Institut Pprime, ISAE-ENSMA, Université de Poitiers, CNRS, 86961 Futuroscope Cedex, France

corresponding_authors.name: Yves Nadot
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institut Pprime, ISAE-ENSMA, Université de Poitiers, CNRS, 86961 Futuroscope Cedex, France

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10Mg铝合金的疲劳寿命预测，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、多孔结构或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses an industrial aluminum alloy (AlSi10Mg) which is not biocompatible, and does not address porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用CT数据预测激光粉末床熔融AlSi10Mg合金的疲劳寿命
summary_zh.method: 基于CT扫描的缺陷表征与疲劳寿命建模
summary_zh.result: CT数据可有效预测疲劳寿命，提高评估精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳实验验证CT预测结果

summary_en.motivation: To predict the fatigue life of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion using computed tomography data.
summary_en.method: CT scans were used to characterize internal defects and build a fatigue life prediction model.
summary_en.result: The CT-based predictions showed good agreement with experimental fatigue tests, improving accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Fatigue experiments on LPBF AlSi10Mg specimens were conducted to validate the predictive model.

papers.title: Effect of heat treatment on the anisotropic microstructural and mechanical properties of Co–Cr–Mo alloys produced by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Removable Partial Prosthodontics, Oral Health Sciences, Graduate School of Medical and Dental Sciences, Tokyo Medical and Dental University, 1-5-45 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo, 113-8549, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Yuka Kajima
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Removable Partial Prosthodontics, Oral Health Sciences, Graduate School of Medical and Dental Sciences, Tokyo Medical and Dental University, 1-5-45 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo, 113-8549, Japan; Department of Dental Materials, Nihon University School of Dentistry, 1-8-13 Kanda-Surugadai, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, 101-8310, Japan. Electronic address: takaichi.yuka@nihon-u.ac.jp

papers.venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials/Journal of mechanical behavior of biomedical materials

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化制备Co-Cr-Mo合金的热处理对各向异性组织与力学性能的影响，虽未涉及多孔结构或疲劳，但对理解生物医用合金的LPBF工艺与性能调控有参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface roughness/osseointegration, which are the core requirements of the AM Biomedical Materials direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM制备Co-Cr-Mo合金各向异性组织与力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备样品，进行不同热处理，测试各向异性拉伸性能和组织表征。
summary_zh.result: 热处理可显著改变组织各向异性，优化力学性能各向异性比。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和显微组织观察验证热处理效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat treatment on the anisotropic microstructure and mechanical properties of Co-Cr-Mo alloys fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated via SLM and subjected to various heat treatments, followed by anisotropic tensile testing and microstructural characterization using EBSD and XRD.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered the anisotropic grain structure and reduced the anisotropy of mechanical properties, achieving improved strength-ductility balance.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through uniaxial tensile tests along different orientations and microstructural analysis.
